chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Al-Amraki, from Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), said:

I asked him about a group of people who had pronounced one Takbeer or two over a funeral, and another (funeral) was placed with it. How should they deal with it? He said: If they wish, they can leave the first one until they finish the Takbeer over the second; and if they wish, they can lift the first one and complete what remains over the second. All of that is acceptable.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: There is no problem with it / It is acceptable

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling when a second funeral arrives during the funeral prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the jurisprudential flexibility (ikhtiyar) in congregational funeral prayers, allowing the Imam or congregation to either complete the current prayer or switch focus to the newly arrived deceased. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on practical ease and the validity of both methods, ensuring the ritual is not disrupted by the dynamic nature of communal gatherings.
